t: Smith and Locke Asker WC door handles are a pair of internal lever on backplate handles, perfect for bathroom and toilet installations. These polished chrome door handles are fire rated for 30 and 60 minutes, providing crucial safety compliance for commercial washrooms and residential projects. Constructed from durable aluminium and zinc, they offer a modern design and robust performance. The handles are suitable for timber doors between 35-45mm thick and are compatible with bathroom locks. Fixings and fittings are supplied for a complete and efficient installation.
b: Fire Door Rating: FD30, FD60 (Timber) & Not Suitable for Steel Fire Doors
Fire Tested to 30 & 60mins on Timber Fire Doors
